description: Fleet-wide backup health, failure triage and usage reports for every tenant on your Comet Server, plus the admin API calls an MSP uses day to day.

env_var_specs.name: COMET_BACKUP_PASSWORD

tools.name: backup_jobs_abandon
tools.description: Mark a running job as abandoned. This will change the status of a running job to abandoned. This is intended to be used on jobs which are definitely no longer running but are stuck in the running state; it will not attempt to cancel the job. If the job is detected to still be running after being marked as abandoned, it will be revived. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/job/abandon with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 23.9.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminjobabandon-mark-a-running-job-as-abandoned. Required: JobID, TargetUser. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

tools.name: backup_jobs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running job. A request is sent to the live-connected device, asking it to cancel the operation. This may fail if there is no live-connection. Only jobs from Comet 18.3.5 or newer can be cancelled. A job can only be cancelled if it has a non-empty CancellationID field in its properties. If the device is running Comet 21.9.5 or later, this API will wait up to ten seconds for a confirmation from the client. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/job/cancel with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 18.3.5 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminjobcancel-cancel-a-running-job. Required: JobID, TargetUser. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

tools.name: backup_jobs_range
tools.description: Get jobs (for date range). The jobs are returned in an unspecified order. If the Start parameter is later than End, they will be swapped. This API will return all jobs that either started or ended within the supplied range. Incomplete jobs have an end time of 0. You can use this API to find only incomplete jobs by setting both Start and End to 0. Prior to Comet Server 22.6.0, additional Incomplete jobs may have been returned if you specified non-zero arguments for both Start and End. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/get-jobs-for-date-range with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.6.8 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#admingetjobsfordaterange-get-jobs-for-date-range. Required: End, Start. Returns array of BackupJobDetail.

tools.name: devices_browse-snapshot
tools.description: Request a list of stored objects inside an existing backup job. The remote device must have given consent for an MSP to browse their files. To service this request, the remote device must connect to the Storage Vault and load index data. There may be a small delay. If the remote device is running Comet 20.12.0 or later, the necessary index data is cached when this API is first called, for 15 minutes after the last repeated call. This can improve performance for interactively browsing an entire tree of stored objects. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/dispatcher/request-stored-objects with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 19.3.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#admindispatcherrequeststoredobjects-request-a-list-of-stored-objects-inside-an-existing-backup-job. Required: Destination, SnapshotID, TargetID. Optional: Options, TreeID. Returns the new DispatcherStoredObjectsResponse.

params.name: Options
params.description: Request a list of stored objects in vmdk file (>= 21.12.5). JSON-encoded VMDKSnapshotViewOptions

params.name: TreeID
params.description: Browse objects inside subdirectory of backup snapshot. If it is for VMDK single file restore, it should be the disk image's subtree ID.

tools.description: Get current campaign status. This API is only available for top-level administrator accounts, not for Tenant administrator accounts. This API requires the Software Build Role to be enabled. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/update-campaign/status with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.9.6 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminupdatecampaignstatus-get-current-campaign-status. Returns the new UpdateCampaignStatus.

tools.name: server_update-news
tools.description: Get software update news from the software provider. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/meta/software-update-news with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 18.3.7 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminmetasoftwareupdatenews-get-software-update-news-from-the-software-provider. Returns the new SoftwareUpdateNewsResponse.

tools.name: server_version
tools.description: Get server properties. Retrieve the version number and basic properties about the server. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/meta/version with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminmetaversion-get-server-properties. Returns the new ServerMetaVersionInfo.

tools.name: storage_bucket
tools.description: Retrieve properties for a single bucket. This API can also be used to refresh the size measurement for a single bucket by passing a valid AfterTimestamp parameter. This API requires the Storage Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/storage/bucket-properties with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 20.9.4 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminstoragebucketproperties-retrieve-properties-for-a-single-bucket. Required: BucketID. Optional: AfterTimestamp. Returns the new BucketProperties.

params.name: AfterTimestamp
params.description: Allow a stale size measurement if it is at least as new as the supplied Unix timestamp. Timestamps in the future may produce a result clamped down to the Comet Server's current time. If not present, the size measurement may be arbitrarily stale.

tools.name: storage_buckets
tools.description: List all buckets. This API requires the Storage Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/storage/list-buckets with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminstoragelistbuckets-list-all-buckets. Returns the new StorageBucketsResponse.

tools.name: storage_free-space
tools.description: Retrieve available space metrics. Access to this API may be prevented on a per-administrator basis. This API requires the Storage Role to be enabled. This API is only available for top-level administrator accounts, not for Tenant administrator accounts. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/storage/free-space with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 19.12.4 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminstoragefreespace-retrieve-available-space-metrics. Optional: BucketID. Returns the new StorageFreeSpaceInfo.

tools.name: storage_request-vault
tools.description: Request a new Storage Vault on behalf of a user. This action does not respect the 'Prevent creating new Storage Vaults (via Request)' policy setting. New Storage Vaults can be requested regardless of the policy setting. Prior to Comet 19.8.0, the response type was CometAPIResponseMessage (i.e. no DestinationID field in response). The StorageProvider must exist for the target user account's organization. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/request-storage-vault with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 18.6.2 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminrequeststoragevault-request-a-new-storage-vault-on-behalf-of-a-user. Required: StorageProvider, TargetUser. Optional: DeviceID, ProfileHash, SelfAddress. Returns the new RequestStorageVaultResponseMessage.

params.name: DeviceID
params.description: The ID of the device to be added as a associated device of the Storage Vault (>= 24.12.0)

params.name: ProfileHash
params.description: The profile hash of the user profile (>= 25.3.2)

params.name: SelfAddress
params.description: The external URL for this server. Used to resolve conflicts

params.name: StorageProvider
params.description: ID for the storage template destination

params.name: TargetUser
params.description: The user to receive the new Storage Vault

tools.name: storage_vault-providers
tools.description: Get the available options for Requesting a Storage Vault. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/request-storage-vault-providers with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 18.6.2 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminrequeststoragevaultproviders-get-the-available-options-for-requesting-a-storage-vault. Optional: TargetOrganization. Returns the new StorageVaultProvidersResponse.

params.name: TargetOrganization
params.description: If present, list the storage template options belonging to another organization. Only allowed for administrator accounts in the top-level organization. (>= 22.5.0)

tools.name: user_groups_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single user group object. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/user-groups/get with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 24.12.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminusergroupsget-retrieve-a-single-user-group-object. Required: GroupID. Optional: IncludeUsers. Returns the new GetUserGroupWithUsersResponse.

params.name: GroupID
params.description: The user group ID to retrieve

params.name: IncludeUsers
params.description: If present, includes the users array in the response.

tools.name: user_groups_list
tools.description: List all user group names. For the top-level organization, the API result includes all user groups for all organizations, unless the TargetOrganization parameter is present. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/user-groups/list with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 24.12.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminusergroupslist-list-all-user-group-names. Optional: TargetOrganization. Returns the new UserGroupsListResponse.

params.name: TargetOrganization
params.description: If present, list the user groups belonging to another organization. Only allowed for administrator accounts in the top-level organization.

tools.name: user_groups_list-full
tools.description: Get all user group objects. For the top-level organization, the API result includes all user groups for all organizations, unless the TargetOrganization parameter is present. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/user-groups/list-full with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 24.12.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminusergroupslistfull-get-all-user-group-objects. Optional: TargetOrganization. Returns the new UserGroupsListFullResponse.

params.name: TargetOrganization
params.description: If present, list the user groups belonging to the specified organization. Only allowed for administrator accounts in the top-level organization.

tools.name: users_add
tools.description: Add a new user account. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/add-user with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminadduser-add-a-new-user-account. Required: TargetPassword, TargetUser. Optional: RequirePasswordChange, StoreRecoveryCode, TargetOrganization. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

params.name: RequirePasswordChange
params.description: If set to 1, require to reset password at the first login for the generated user (>= 20.3.4)

params.name: StoreRecoveryCode
params.description: If set to 1, store and keep a password recovery code for the generated user (>= 18.3.9)

params.name: TargetOrganization
params.description: If present, create the user account on behalf of another organization. Only allowed for administrator accounts in the top-level organization. (>= 22.5.0)

tools.name: users_delete
tools.description: Delete user account. This does not remove any storage buckets. Unused storage buckets will be cleaned up by the Constellation Role. Any stored data can not be decrypted without the user profile. Misuse can cause data loss! This also allows to uninstall software from active devices under the user account This also removes all job history for the user account. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/delete-user with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#admindeleteuser-delete-user-account. Required: TargetUser. Optional: UninstallConfig. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

tools.name: users_disable-totp
tools.description: Disable user account 2FA(TOTP) authentication. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/disable-user-totp with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 20.6.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#admindisableusertotp-disable-user-account-2fa-totp-authentication. Required: TargetUser. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

tools.name: users_get
tools.description: Get user account profile. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/get-user-profile with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. The response contains credential material (account password hash, TOTP key, recovery code, and Storage Vault access credentials). Treat the output as secret. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#admingetuserprofile-get-user-account-profile. Required: TargetUser. Returns the new UserProfileConfig.

tools.name: users_list
tools.description: List all user accounts. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/list-users with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminlistusers-list-all-user-accounts. Returns array of string.

tools.name: users_list-full
tools.description: List all user account profiles. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/list-users-full with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. The response contains credential material (account password hash, TOTP key, recovery code, and Storage Vault access credentials). Treat the output as secret. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminlistusersfull-list-all-user-account-profiles. Returns the new UsersListFullResponse.

tools.name: users_reset-password
tools.description: Reset user account password. The user account must have a recovery code present. A new replacement recovery code will be generated automatically. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/reset-user-password with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 18.3.9 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminresetuserpassword-reset-user-account-password. Required: NewPassword, TargetUser. Optional: OldPassword. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

params.name: OldPassword
params.description: Old account password. Required if no recovery code is present for the user account. (>= 20.3.2)

tools.name: users_revoke-device
tools.description: Revoke device from user account. It's possible to simply remove the Device section from the user's profile, however, using this dedicated API will also gracefully handle live connections. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/revoke-device with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.9.1 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminrevokedevice-revoke-device-from-user-account. Required: TargetDevice, TargetUser. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

tools.name: users_set-profile
tools.description: Modify user account profile. This API requires the Auth Role to be enabled. Wire format: POST /api/v1/admin/set-user-profile with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The CLI adds the admin credential fields (Username, AuthType, Password or SessionKey) to the body itself. Requires Comet Server 17.2.0 or later. Source: https://docs.cometbackup.com/latest/api/api-methods#adminsetuserprofile-modify-user-account-profile. Required: ProfileData, TargetUser. Optional: AdminOptions. Returns the new CometApiresponseMessage.

params.name: AdminOptions
params.description: Instructions for modifying user profile (>= 24.12.5). JSON-encoded AdminOptions

novel_features.name: Fleet backup health
novel_features.description: See the backup state of every protected item across every tenant in one list, including items that quietly stopped running.

novel_features.name: Failure triage with error lines
novel_features.description: Find out why backups failed: the failed and stuck jobs in a time window (warnings with --include-warnings), with the first error lines from each job log.

novel_features.name: Per-tenant usage report
novel_features.description: Get per-tenant storage against quota, billable devices, booster engines, Microsoft 365 accounts and VM guests; these are the server's own counts, not an invoice.

novel_features.name: Stale and offline devices
novel_features.description: Find offline devices: registered devices not connected now, ranked by how long since their last backup, flagged when they still carry billable protected items.

novel_features.name: Changes between snapshots
novel_features.description: Compare the two newest local snapshots: problems opened or resolved, devices and protected items added or removed, storage growth. Run snapshot twice first.

novel_features.name: Re-run failed backups
novel_features.description: Plan and, with --yes, re-run failed scheduled backups on devices that are online now; quota, cancelled, already-running, custom-job and offline-device failures are skipped.

novel_features.name: Outdated client versions
novel_features.description: List devices whose Comet client version differs from the server version, with the connection id an online device needs for devices update-software.

novel_features.name: Fleet snapshot
novel_features.description: Capture the current fleet into a local SQLite store so changes can compare runs.
